prompt: Why will the receiver stay with the trainer?
promptZh: 為什麼接收器要留給講師？

options.text: She needs another practice button for class.
options.zh: 她上課還需要一個教學用按鈕。
options.whyZh: 兩個教學用按鈕會先歸還；暫留的是接收器。

options.text: It is still paired with her tablet.
options.whyZh: 接收器仍與講師的平板配對，要等她解除配對再歸還。

options.text: There is no room for it in the case.
options.whyZh: 對話沒有提箱容量問題，暫留理由是尚未解除配對。

options.text: It has already been checked back in.
options.whyZh: 接收器還沒送回，才需要登記分批歸還。

explanationZh: 接收器仍與講師的平板配對，要等她解除配對再歸還。
evidence: Class ended early. Can I return our practice kit? The receiver’s still paired with the trainer’s tablet. / Put both practice buttons in the case and return it first. Leave the receiver with the trainer until she unpairs it.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Class ended early. Can I return our practice kit? The receiver’s still paired with the trainer’s tablet.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Put both practice buttons in the case and return it first. Leave the receiver with the trainer until she unpairs it.
